name: agent-workflows
description: This repository is its own marketplace: it hosts the agent-workflows plugin from the same tree it develops it in, so the placed copy and the tested copy are one thing.

plugins.name: agent-workflows
plugins.description: Slash commands that make an AI coding agent follow an exact, documented order: dev-workflow (dw-*) turns a need into shipped work, qa-workflow (qw-*) authors test docs, doc-workflow (doc-*) writes a README. Each producer is paired with a review gate; every project-specific value resolves from that project's .claude/rules/project-profile.md.
